facts.fact: The paper titled 'Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragon's Diet?' was published by Amal Doua at the University of Leicester.
The study investigates the feasibility of Hiccup supplying enough fish to maintain Toothless, a Night Fury dragon's diet.
Toothless would require 13 Icelandic cod and 56 Atlantic salmon every day while trapped, totaling 716 kg of fish over twelve days.
Hiccup would have needed to carry 828 fish weighing a total of 8592 kg over twelve days, which was deemed unrealistic.
